name: Elephant Crisis Fund
summary: A pooled fund that makes fast, often short-term grants to trusted partners working against elephant poaching and ivory trafficking, on human-elephant coexistence and on protecting elephant landscapes.

administered_by.quote: The Elephant Crisis Fund is a partnership between WCN and the Save the Elephants (STE), but is managed by STE.

applicant_types.quote: In general, we prefer to give grants to NGOs working within an established framework such as 501c3 or equivalent status, and only provide grants directly to governments under exceptional circumstances.

geography.quote: the Elephant Crisis Fund (ECF) identifies and supports the most effective projects and partners in Africa, and in ivory consuming nations

access.quote: The streamlined administration of the ECF means that we cannot accept unsolicited proposals because of the time involved in assessing unknown potential partners and their proposals.

amount.quote: The ECF tends to fund projects between $15,000 and $200,000
